seo.description: Ikakasal sina {0} at {1} sa {2} sa Singapore. Nandito ang wedding details, RSVP, at iba pang info.
seo.keywords: kasal nina {0} at {1}, kasal nina {0} {1} sa Singapore, wedding RSVP

hero.headline: {0}, ikakasal na kami sa puso ng Lion City, at sana makasama ka namin! Basahin pa para makita ang lahat ng details para sa special day namin.

metAtWork.title: Dito Nagsimula
metAtWork.body: Una kaming nagkakilala sa work. Madalas lang kaming nagkakasalubong sa meetings, hindi namin alam na simula na pala iyon ng something special.

coffeeRuns.title: Kape, Takbo, at Kami
coffeeRuns.body: Noong Abril 2017, habang nagkakape, naging official kami. Lumalim ang relationship namin sa cafe hopping, good talks, at running together.

programming.title: Shared Passion
programming.body: Work has always been something we both connect with, at naging another way ito para sabay kaming mag-grow. Through each other's guidance, natulungan namin ang isa't isa lumapit sa dreams namin.

longDistance.title: Long Distance Love
longDistance.body: May short season na naging long distance kami nang lumipat si Mead sa Singapore para sa bagong chapter ng career niya.

lionCity.title: To the Lion City
lionCity.body: Pagkalipas ng five months, sinundan ni Eleaz ang love of her life sa Singapore.

fluffyEra.title: Our Softest Season
fluffyEra.body: Sobrang happy namin together kaya naging chubbiest, fluffiest, at cutest version kami ng sarili namin.

fitnessJourney.title: Balik sa Daan
fitnessJourney.body: After naming pagdaanan ang highs and lows ng life together, binalikan namin ang isa sa first love languages namin: running together.

proposal.title: The Question of a Lifetime
proposal.body: Nag-ask si Eleaz for forever, at yes ang sagot ni Mead.
proposal.photoCaption1: A promise made beneath Taiwan’s skies

bigDay.title: The Wedding Day
bigDay.body: Sisimulan namin ang married life namin kasama ang mga taong nagmahal, nagdasal, at sumuporta sa amin.

venues.heading: Mga Venue
venues.body: Dalawang beautiful places ang magiging setting ng pinaka-meaningful parts ng araw namin: isang sacred beginning at isang celebration by the bay.

church.name: St. Joseph's Church Victoria Street 2:00 PM
church.description: Isang historic Catholic church sa heart ng Singapore, kung saan magsisimula ang married life namin with beauty, tradition, and prayer.

reception.name: The Lighthouse Fullerton 6:00 PM
reception.description: Nasa 8th floor ng The Fullerton Hotel Singapore, isang elegant rooftop dining spot na tanaw ang Marina Bay. Dito magpapatuloy ang celebration with dinner, stories, and city lights.

rsvp.heading: RSVP

deadline.closedMessage: Closed na ang RSVP updates. Thank you for understanding.

rsvp.note: Alam naming may ilan sa inyo na kailangang bumiyahe para makapunta sa wedding namin, kaya super appreciated namin ang time, effort, at planning ninyo. At the same time, no pressure at all. Sobrang saya namin kung makakasama namin kayo, pero mahalaga rin sa amin ang love and well wishes ninyo.
rsvp.successMessage: Thank you! Na-submit na ang RSVP mo.
rsvp.successNote: Pwede mong gamitin ulit ang invitation link mo para i-update ang response mo before the RSVP deadline.
rsvp.confirmBody: Pakicheck muna bago i-submit. Pwede mo pa ring i-update ang response mo before the RSVP deadline.
rsvp.reviewReminder: Note lang: may dalawang St. Joseph’s Church sa Singapore. Ang wedding ceremony namin ay sa St. Joseph’s Church, Victoria Street. Pakicheck ang address bago pumunta para hindi malito.
rsvp.errorMessage: May something wrong. Please try again or message us directly.

weddingTimeline.heading: Wedding Timeline
weddingTimeline.body: Quick look sa flow ng wedding day namin, from ceremony hanggang evening celebration. Gagawin namin ang best namin to follow the schedule, pero baka may konting changes sa actual day.
weddingTimeline.note: Mag-share pa kami ng more detailed timeline habang papalapit ang big day, so please check this website for updates.

partyAssembles.title: Wedding Party Assembles
partyAssembles.description: Magkikita-kita ang immediate family and wedding entourage para mag-prepare for the ceremony.

ceremonyBegins.title: Ceremony Begins
ceremonyBegins.description: Sisimulan namin ang wedding Mass surrounded by family, friends, and prayer.

massConcludes.title: Wedding Mass Concludes
massConcludes.description: After the Mass, please stay for group photos sa church. Magkikita-kita ulit tayo later for the dinner reception.

break.title: Important Note
break.description: May two and a half hours na free time between ceremony and dinner reception. Pwede kayong mag-relax, mamasyal nearby, or bumalik sa accommodation para mag-freshen up before the evening celebration.

guestArrival.title: Guest Arrival at The Lighthouse Fullerton
guestArrival.description: Magkikita-kita ulit tayo para ituloy ang celebration sa evening reception.

dinnerBegins.title: Dinner and Celebration Begins
dinnerBegins.description: Dinner, speeches, tawanan, at celebration begin habang umiilaw ang city lights.

sde.title: A Special Wedding Film
sde.description: May prepared kaming Same-Day Edit with moments from our wedding day. Sana makapag-stay kayo until the end of the programme para mapanood natin ito together bago matapos ang gabi.

receptionConcludes.title: Reception Concludes
receptionConcludes.description: Tatapusin namin ang gabi with full hearts.

whatToWear.heading: What to Wear

ladies.heading: For Ladies
ladies.body: Welcome ang dresses, elegant jumpsuits, or dressy separates. We would love to see you in soft pink or light brown. Please save the white dresses for the bride!

gentlemen.heading: For Gentlemen
gentlemen.body: Recommended ang suit, blazer with tailored trousers, or long-sleeved dress shirt with formal trousers. Please avoid shorts, jeans, T-shirts, and slippers. Gray, brown, white, or soft pink are welcome.

whatToWear.closing: Please dress elegantly and comfortably for our church ceremony and evening celebration.
whatToWear.imageButtonAriaLabel: Open the attire guide in a larger view

whereToStay.heading: Saan Mag-stay

recommendation.suffix: , kasi convenient ang locations na ito between our two venues - St. Joseph’s Church and The Fullerton Hotel. Ang hotels below ay nasa central and connected areas, with easy access to public transport, food, and other amenities.

whereToStay.closing: Hindi kami ang mag-a-arrange ng accommodation, so we suggest comparing rates and booking early since prices and availability can change.

giftRegistry.heading: A Note on Gifts
giftRegistry.body: If you would like to bless us with a wedding gift,
giftRegistry.closing: we would sincerely appreciate a monetary contribution toward our future together.

questionsAndAnswers.heading: Questions & Answers
questionsAndAnswers.body: A few helpful notes habang nagpe-prepare kayo to celebrate with us.

rsvpDeadline.question: Kailan dapat mag-RSVP?
rsvpDeadline.answer: Please send your RSVP by 31 Oktubre 2026 para ma-finalize namin ang arrangements on time.

plusOnes.question: Pwede ba akong magsama ng plus one?
plusOnes.answer: Since may reserved number of seats kami, invited guests named on your invitation lang ang kaya naming i-accommodate. Kung may plus one, lalabas ang name nila sa RSVP section ng invitation mo. Sorry, hindi namin maa-accommodate ang unlisted guests. Thank you for understanding.

dressCode.question: Ano ang susuotin ko?
dressCode.answer: Formal or cocktail attire, please. For ladies, soft pink and light brown are welcome, while white dresses are reserved for the bride. For gentlemen, black, brown, gray, white, or soft pink are welcome.

timelineDetails.question: Mag-share ba kayo ng more detailed timeline?
timelineDetails.answer: Yes. Mag-share kami ng more detailed info closer to the big day, so please check this website for updates.

kids.question: Pwede bang magsama ng kids sa wedding?
kids.answer: To keep our celebration intimate, adults-only muna ang wedding namin. Exceptions lang ang kids na part ng immediate family ng couple or wedding entourage. Thank you for understanding.

flightAccom.question: Provided ba ang flights and accommodation?
flightAccom.answer: Guests will need to arrange and cover their own flights and accommodation, unless we personally told you otherwise. Super appreciated namin ang time, effort, and planning para makasama namin kayo on our special day. For suggested places to stay, please check the “Saan Mag-stay” section of this website.

AccomRecommendations.question: Saan ninyo suggest mag-stay?
AccomRecommendations.answer: We recommend staying around Bencoolen, Bugis, or City Hall, kasi convenient ang areas na ito between St. Joseph’s Church and our reception venue at The Fullerton Hotel. Good options include Hotel Mi Bencoolen, V Hotel Bencoolen, and ibis Singapore on Bencoolen for more budget-friendly stays, plus lyf Funan Singapore and Carlton Hotel Singapore for guests who prefer more comfort and convenience. These hotels are central, well-connected, and near public transport, food, and other amenities. Hindi kami ang mag-a-arrange ng accommodation, so we suggest comparing rates and booking early since prices and availability can change.
